title: Inventory tracker with stock movements and low stock alerts
when: The user wants to track product stock with incoming and outgoing movements, minimum levels and alerts for low stock.
prompt:
Goal: Stock derived from a movement log, never edited by hand, with low stock visible at a glance.
Steps:
1. Product { sku, name, unit, minStock, cost } and movements { id, sku, qty (plus in, minus out), reason, at }; stock is the sum.
2. logic.mjs: stockOf(movements, sku), applyMovement refusing an out above stock, lowStock(products, movements), valueOnHand.
3. Products table with th headers: SKU, name, on hand, minimum, status as the word OK or Low; search by SKU or name.
4. Stock in or out form: product select, quantity, reason (purchase, sale, adjustment, loss); errors in role="alert".
5. History per product with dates and running balance; a banner lists items at or under minimum.
6. Persist in localStorage inventory.v1 guarded; CSV export with quoted fields.
7. test.mjs: sums, refused negative stock, low stock list.
Quality bar:
- Every change has a reason and date.
- Status readable without color.
- SKU unique.
Pitfalls:
- Editing the stock number directly.
- Allowing negative stock silently.
- Floats for unit cost.
Verify:
- [ ] Table uses th.
- [ ] Form labeled.
- [ ] Alert region present.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (movements and stock), test.mjs.

examples.input: controle de estoque da minha loja
examples.output: products table with Low badge, in/out form, movement history, CSV export
